question: Where is the breath-filling vital air said to be situated in living beings?
premises: The vital air fills with breath
This air is present in beings
Its presence extends to all living beings
inference: The breath-filling vital air is situated in all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement of saṃsthitam with vāyuḥ is unusual in form.
plain_english: The breath-filling vital air is situated in all living beings.
